Crowd Contact Lift.name: Crowd Contact Lift
Crowd Contact Lift.description: The user touches one person with all five fingertip pads and spreads weightlessness through people touching that target, continuing through a connected crowd across a city block. Dozens float for up to three turns, beyond the ordinary three-tonne limit, and attacks needing ground traction lose their footing. Disconnected people are unaffected; allies in the chain also float. The user cannot steer the crowd and is unable to activate the Quirk again for the scene. Strain: severe.
